sn41.5:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā kāmabhū macchikāsaṇḍe viharati ambāṭakavane.
sn41.5:1.2: atha kho citto gahapati yenāyasmā kāmabhū tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ kāmabhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cittaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā kāmabhū etadavoca:
sn41.5:4.1: imassa nu kho gahapati saṃkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti?
sn41.5:4.2: kinnu kho etaṃ bhante bhagavatā bhāsitanti?
sn41.5:4.4: tena hi bhante muhuttaṃ āgamehi yāvassa atthaṃ pekkhāmīti.
sn41.5:4.5: atha kho citto gahapati muhuttaṃ tuṇhī hutvā āyasmantaṃ kāmabhuṃ etadavoca:
sn41.5:5.2: setapacchādoti kho bhante vimuttiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn41.5:5.3: ekāroti kho bhante satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn41.5:5.5: rathoti kho bhante imassetaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsūpacayassa aniccucchādana parimaddana bhedana viddhaṃsana dhammassa.
sn41.5:5.6: rāgo kho bhante nīgho doso nīgho moho nīgho.
sn41.5:5.7: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn41.5:5.9: āyantanti kho bhante arahato etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn41.5:5.10: sototi kho bhante taṇhāya etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn41.5:5.11: sā khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn41.5:5.13: rāgo kho bhante bandhanaṃ, doso bandhanaṃ, moho bandhanaṃ.
sn41.5:5.14: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn41.5:5.16: iti kho bhante yantaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā:
sn41.5:7.1: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn41.5:7.3: yassa te gambhīre buddhavacane paññācakkhu kamatīti.
